map.title: Map

messages.title: Messages
messages.hint: All your conversations — tap a row for chat. Next to each: {{video}} and {{audio}} for a direct call.

reviewSwipes.title: Review swipes
reviewSwipes.explainer: Review profiles you liked or passed. A new choice is saved only if you tap Like or Pass. “Next” only moves to the next profile without changing anything.

premium.title: Premium
premium.subtitle: Optional extras. Core features are free during launch.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password?
forgotPassword.chooseIntro: Choose how you want to recover your account:
forgotPassword.btnScan: Recover by scanning with your phone
forgotPassword.sessionExpired: The session has expired. Try again.
forgotPassword.errSend: Could not send the reset email.
forgotPassword.errRecovery: Could not start recovery. Try again.
forgotPassword.emailSentLine2: Open the link in the email to reset your password. Check your spam folder too.
forgotPassword.devP1: The email link points to the app’s public domain (e.g. chat.diebel.ro — not localhost). That’s correct in production. This box only appears with npm run dev: to reset on the same PC without opening mail on production, use the link below (expires in ~15 minutes).
forgotPassword.scanIntro: Open the Align app on your phone (or this site in the phone browser), stay logged in, then scan the code below or open the link.
forgotPassword.scanWarnTitle: Chrome on your phone may upgrade http:// to https:// for IP addresses → the same “connection is not private” error, even if the link here is correct.
forgotPassword.scanWarnP1: Recommended: keep npm run dev:lan running, open a second terminal in align-app and run npm run tunnel:lt. Copy the https://… URL shown and set it in .env as NEXT_PUBLIC_MOBILE_RECOVER_ORIGIN= (no trailing slash), restart dev and generate the QR again. The first open on your phone may ask for “Continue” on the localtunnel page — that’s normal.
forgotPassword.scanWarnP2: Alternatively: Chrome on phone → Settings → Privacy → turn off “Always use secure connections” / HTTPS-First; or try Firefox on the phone with the same http:// link.
forgotPassword.scanWaiting: Waiting for confirmation on your phone…
forgotPassword.emailIntro1: Enter your account email and we’ll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.emailIntro2: Check your spam folder if you don’t receive the email.
